name: MultiRS07
title: RS07 indel model with two rate components

citation.title: Incorporating indel information into phylogeny estimation for rapidly emerging pathogens.

args.name: f1
args.description: The weight of the lower-rate component

args.name: meanLength
args.description: The mean indel length in alignment symbols; must be at least 1

args.name: topology
args.description: The tree topology, normally supplied automatically

description:
Combines two insertion-deletion rates when calculating branch gap-opening probabilities. The parameter rate is their weighted mean: f1*rate1 + (1-f1)*rate2 = rate, with rate2/rate1 = exp(logRatio).

The two event probabilities are averaged before constructing a single pairwise alignment model for each branch; sites do not retain separate rate-category assignments along the tree. Indel lengths are geometrically distributed with the same mean for both components, measured in alignment symbols. Insertions and deletions are symmetric. Rates are relative to the substitution rate, as in RS07.
